title: Stroke with a capacity change, Baa
story: 15:00, Kendhoo (Baa). 70-year-old woman, sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech, onset 50 minutes ago.
proves: Starts routed to IGMH; presenter toggles IGMH CT off and the engine re-plans to Kulhudhuffushi RH live.
intake_text: My mother suddenly has weakness in her right arm and leg and slurred speech, it started about 50 minutes ago. Her face is drooping on the right side.
presenter_notes: In /hospital open Capacity and switch IGMH CT off. Within one poll the recommendation flips to Kulhudhuffushi RH.
